'''Knoke''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated at some point during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], the Rodian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Knoke took on the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]] as a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] apprentice. Knoke was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] while attempting to capture a rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], though Leeachos subsequently finished the job and claimed the contract placed on the Jedi. Knoke left his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and Leeachos, and the Nikto used his master's equipment to help himself to forge a successful bounty hunting career of his own.<ref name="UABS" />
